## Counts

| Measure | Value |
|---|---|
| Organizing units (categories, specialty areas, job roles) | 81 |
| Job roles | 40 |
| Strict elements (Task, Knowledge, Skill statements) | 1,419 |
| Elements per organizing unit | 17.5 |
| Elements per job role | 35.5 |

The document states its own size: five categories, twelve specialty
areas, and forty job roles. Job-role cards in the source name only
Task, Knowledge, and Skill statement codes; the statement text itself
lives in separate appendix tables keyed by those codes, which this
ingestion joins back to each role.

:::

**License**

The document carries no copyright line or licence notice; its only markings, "TLP: Clear" and "Document Classification: Public," are disclosure markings rather than licences. NCA granted cybedtools written permission on 2026-09-20 to ingest and redistribute the content on three conditions: NCA cited as issuing body and source, everything taken from the document carried verbatim with no paraphrase or in-house translation, and anything cybedtools derives marked as derived rather than presented as NCA content.
:::

## Caveats

- The hierarchy edges between job role, specialty area, and category are **cybedtools's own derivation**, not a structure NCA published as edges. They are marked as derived per the terms of NCA's permission.
- NCA's grant named an **earlier edition** (SCyWF – 1: 2020) that NCA no longer publishes; the current 1.5: 2026 edition is ingested by owner decision under the same permission.
- The document's own disclaimer makes its **Arabic version binding** for matters of meaning and interpretation. cybedtools ingests the English version only.
